note: Original description, published in the genus Termes (Froggatt 1898); the alate was then unknown, only the soldier and worker are recorded. The original measures in lines (line, 1 line ≈ 2.12 mm).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head bright yellow, the apex of the mandibles dark rusty; base of each antennal segment paler; thorax pale yellow, the rest white; body length about 2.5 lines (about 5.3 mm). Head globose, slightly longer than wide, posterior margin rounded, the sides sloping up to the base of the mandibles, the top arched; frons rounded, with a few long hairs, a pale red spot on each side; antennae 15-segmented: segment 1 very large, arising from the side of the head, segment 2 about half its length and width, segment 3 very short, segments 4—11 moniliform, segments 12—14 stalked, larger and truncate at the apex, segment 15 long-oval; clypeus hidden beneath the head, indistinct; labrum wide, rounded at the apex, reaching the middle of the mandibles; mandibles sickle-shaped, overlapping each other at the apex, the inner edge smooth for about one-third of the way from the apex to the base, deeply notched there, widening again towards the base; maxillary palps slender. Pronotum narrower than the head, anterior margin slightly concave, sides and apex rounded; legs slender and long, tibiae short with 2 long basal spines; tarsi long, the terminal segment large, the claws slender; abdomen long-oval, pointed at the end, densely clothed with fine hairs; cerci small and slender.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Whole body white, semi-transparent; head pale yellow; body length about 3 lines (about 6.4 mm). Head wide and arched, posterior margin rounded, longer than wide; a median suture runs from the base into a horn-shaped white patch in the middle of the frons; clypeus divided longitudinally in the middle into two rounded lobes, each with a pale red spot on its outer edge; labrum large, anterior margin rounded; mandibles small, with 2 stout pointed teeth at the apex, tapering from the lower tooth towards a horn-shaped tooth in the middle of the mandible, broad at the base; maxillary palps slender. Pronotum small, anterior margin truncate, the sides sloping towards the posterior margin; abdomen broadly oval.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Alate: the original records "Winged form unknown". Froggatt placed the species in the genus Termes in this work; it was later assigned to Amitermes.
